## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The twelve-character requirement should also cover invitation passwords, which still accept eight-character values.

## Changes
The pull request raises the signup and reset password minima to twelve and updates their boundary tests. Tests were read, not run.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Apply the twelve-character minimum to invitations — Raising only signup and reset minima leaves invitation password `"x" * 8` accepted through the stale minimum at `app/invite.py:1`. — Users creating accounts through invitations can still choose eight- to eleven-character passwords, bypassing the new password requirement. — Fix: Raise `app/invite.py:1` to twelve and extend `test_password_boundaries` at `tests/test_invite.py:6` for the new boundary.

## Suggestions
(none)
